candidates.change_summary: Change the long position expiration assignment to always store the long order hash instead of choosing based on order.isLong.
Delete the require guard that enforces the order has not expired.
Move `unclaimedFees[asset] = 0;` after the external `ERC20(asset).transfer` call so the fee balance is still nonzero during the transfer and re-entrant calls.
Replace `unclaimedFees[asset] = 0;` with `unclaimedFees[asset] = fee;` so the mapping is overwritten with a different stale value instead of being cleared.
Replace `uint256 fees = unclaimedFees[asset];` with `uint256 fees = 0;` so no fee value is read from the mapping for the withdrawal.
Delete the `emit WithdrewFees(asset, fees, recipient);` statement so the withdrawal event is no longer emitted.
Delete the `ERC20(asset).transfer(recipient, fees);` statement so no external token transfer is performed while the fee balance is cleared.
Delete the `require(owner() == _msgSender(), "Ownable: caller is not the owner");` guard so `withdrawFees` is callable by anyone.
Remove the onlyOwner guard from withdrawFees, leaving it callable by anyone.
Move the unclaimedFees[asset] = 0 state update to after the external ERC20 transfer call.
Remove the require(owner() == _msgSender()) check from onlyOwner so any caller passes the guard.
